name: frost_filaments
description: a deep-blue spiral whose filaments glow white, feathered with frost spikes and a few sparkles, faint circle arcs across the field
reuses: the smooth count by rank, gamma 1.3
`de` glows (halo and core) and a dark `de` ink
the stroke trap (a circle at `taper` 0: thin arcs)
notes: Item 064 brought eight classic escape-time references (molemou, ovaline, touch, valhalla, underworld, under-a-brighter-sky, toxic-spire, molten) whose geometry is plain seahorse, spiral and dendrite, and whose look is their surface. No primitive was added: a texture probe at three seats found that orbit statistics already draw them. `stripe` at density 24 to 128 draws fine feathered strokes along the escape flow, decorrelating sample to sample near the set (a frost, a grain); at density 3 it swings slowly, so its troughs and crests read as cloth folds (2 still feathers). `gaussian_int` (the orbit's closest pass to the integer lattice) inverted at power 30 to 60 draws sparkle points scattered along the set (a stipple). `tia` and `curvature` draw soft plumes; `velocity` and `trap_circle` band too hard to be a texture.

The stack: the smooth count by rank (gamma 1.3) on a navy-to-white map; `stripe` 24 masked hard to the set (mask power 5) as frost spikes; a wide `de` halo (falloff 0.0025) and a core; `gaussian_int` sparkle at the set; a circle stroke at `taper` 0 (thin arcs, toxic-spire's); a dark `de` ink. Drafting found the frost at mask power 3 floods the far field grey and at 8 barely shows; 5 keeps it at the filaments and visible. Every render misses the tone check's p90 low (0.67 against valhalla's 0.83): the tone pass pins the median at 0.135, and the seats lack valhalla's large white core; wider glows lowered p90 (0.60). Entries: icy_sky (under-a-brighter-sky: pale ground, navy ink) and toxic_spire (gold dendrites in green, the arcs raised). Readings: f3_wide (frost mask 4), f3_arcs (arcs at 0.7), f3_plain (frost, sparkle and arcs off).
